description: Sepolia WETH ↔ Falcon FETH. Bridge In wraps ETH→WETH, locks WETH, relay mints FETH (currency ETH). No free bootstrap mint.

steps: Open Wallet → Bridge, ensure ETH deposit wallet exists
Add FETH trust line (required before Bridge In)
Fund Sepolia address with test ETH (gas + amount to wrap)
Bridge In FETH: wrap ETH→WETH, approve, lock; relay mints FETH
Send FETH on Falcon like any IOU
deposit_flow.note: Bridge Out (FETH→WETH) not enabled yet — deposit mint path is live.

historical_note: HISTORICAL — Falcon Ledger network 1001 lock-mint. Not live on 2300. Live Sepolia rail: public/config/pl-2300-bridge.json.
